evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating a game; name and optional description are attributes of that feature, not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL; no separate independently implementable features combined.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round via entering an item; the text-field detail is an attribute of the feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the list of items; the example question is justification, not an additional feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting an item (whether for initial estimate or re-estimate are variants of same action).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item; the reason describes the benefit, not a second feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item; no separate independently implementable feature combined.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item; atomic operation.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing all estimates immediately; the explanatory clause clarifies behavior, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the average as the agreed estimate; atomic and testable.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic filling of estimate field under a specific condition; condition is part of the feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: entering the agreed estimate; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story; single implementable action.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories from a spreadsheet; atomic and separable from other import methods.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: copy/paste import; although similar to PP-014, this story itself expresses one feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing previous games; atomic navigation functionality.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing a game transcript; atomic feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript as HTML; distinct from other export formats but itself atomic.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript as CSV; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game and its stored data; atomic action.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation; listed fields are attributes of the single feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: login; atomic and testable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: updating account details; the scope may include multiple fields but remains one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion along with related games; one coherent feature.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying local timezone dates/times; atomic presentation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email; one independently implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting the estimation sequence preference; the two sequences are options within one choice feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: limiting invitations to up to 15; a single constraint/feature.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game by entering a name; atomic user action.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the current item being estimated; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the session's item list; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediate visibility of who has given an estimate; atomic indicator feature.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: synchronized reveal of estimates after all are in; single coherent feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until draw completion; condition is part of the single feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing prior estimates per estimator for current story; atomic view feature.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: seeing per-estimator estimates in current round; atomic display requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a shared two-minute countdown; atomic functionality.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: auto-reset behavior for the shared timer; part of the timer feature, atomic.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: scrolling through prior rounds' data; atomic browsing capability.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering across draws; one UI consistency feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability to change estimate before draw completion; atomic and similar to PP-034 but individual.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing a thumbnail near played cards; atomic UI enhancement.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: standards compliance; mentions two standards as attributes of the same quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing glossary/definitions; atomic documentation feature.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating indexes to improve query performance; atomic developer task.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: cross-browser compatibility requirement; listing multiple browsers are attributes of the same compatibility feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance; single quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: performance/responsiveness requirement; atomic non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support; atomic internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: readable/predictable URLs; single UI/UX requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: friendly error pages; atomic UX requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: anonymized storage of results for research; combines privacy and research goal but expresses one storage requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: metrics/dashboard for usage; atomic reporting feature.
